headline: Earnings climb on a strong year-over-year gain
summary_short: HD Hyundai Electric's Q2 FY2026 EPS was ₩5,740, up about 45% y/y from ₩3,957, though roughly flat q/q against ₩5,781.
summary_long: EPS was ₩5,740 in Q2 FY2026, up roughly 45% y/y from ₩3,957 and essentially flat q/q versus ₩5,781. No revenue, margin, or cash-position figures are available from verified shard data for this kpi-only pass.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. HD Hyundai Electric reports via KRX/DART; no SEC filing or fetchable official press release was found within the WebSearch budget (only third-party news recaps — Seoul Economic Daily, Korea Herald Business, Reuters via TradingView). Those recaps cite Q2 sales of ₩1.14tn (+26% y/y), operating profit of ₩287bn (+37% y/y), and a total order backlog of $8.49bn (+29% y/y) — the backlog figure is captured in extendedMetrics via Step 3b; the revenue/profit figures are not folded into the KPI ledger above, which remains sourced solely from resolver shard data.
